endpoint: Fructose uptake and conversion to fructose 1-phosphate through a PEP-driven fused FruB relay, followed by 1-PFK production of fructose 1,6-bisphosphate.
activity_boundary: Net phosphohistidyl donor to sugar includes an intervening EIIB phosphocysteine; sequence order is not phosphate-flow order.
domain_boundary: EI/HPr/fructose EIIA in one carrier, EIIB/EIIC in one transporter. A second EIIB-like region is not a universal requirement.
oracle: Explicit audited component activity/domain/system facts feed the production Boolean compiler; free-text fusion constraints are not automatically enforced by the compiler.
limits: Passing the matched panel means coverage of the modeled functions under the curated evidence assumptions, not measured native flux in every strain.
Deinococcus full relay is not asserted: restored KDR_B0075 has no established UniProt mapping/PEP-uptake assay.
Azospirillum counterpart locus is not interchangeable by family membership.
Cross-panel mixtures have no asserted matched-system evidence; failure is not a claim that heterologous complementation is impossible.
Free-text architecture is enforced by this explicit audit oracle, not by production compiler feature extraction.
TagK secondary 1-PFK activity and archaeal 1-PFK activity may satisfy a component predicate without establishing a matched fused bacterial pathway.
